name: showreel-c3-all-caps

voice.text: Stop writing in all caps. It's hard to read. Turns out, lowercase words have shapes. Fix one: sentence case. Fix two: caps for short labels. Fix three: space out those caps. Calm, and easy to read.

caption:
Stop writing in all caps. It's hard to read. 🛍️

1. Sentence case. Lowercase letters are taller and shorter (d, h, k, p, y), so words get shapes the eye knows; caps are all one height.
2. Caps for short labels only. A tag or a heading under one line is fine in caps; a paragraph is not.
3. Space out those caps. Add about 5 to 12% letterspacing to text in caps.

Save this for your next flyer, sign or slide. Who in your life types in all caps?

edges_ok.why: the design-tutorial stage (a sale flyer taped to a shop's glass door) fills the frame by design
